description: Identification of a person or entity for rows, lists and tables.

howToUse: Use it to identify a person or company in a table cell or list row: avatar, name and one line of detail.
Put the e-mail or the role in `secondary`, and a short mark such as "you" in `tag`.
Use `size="sm"` in table cells and `md` in lists.
alternatives: A row that opens something or holds a setting: SettingRow or NavCard.

keyboard.action: The cell does not receive focus. Wrap the name in a link when it opens a profile.

props.name: avatar
props.description:
Leading slot: `Avatar` (circle for a person, `shape="square"` for an entity:
project, workspace, organization). Composition: the atom comes from outside.

props.name: tag
props.description: Inline suffix after the name (e.g. mono "you", role `Badge`).

props.name: size
props.description: Density: `sm` for compact table cells, `md` for lists.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
